workflow.name: GitHub Repository Checker
workflow.description: Perform a self-check on a specified GitHub repository and generate a report: repository metadata, latest release/tag, issue/PR statistics, key document presence, document external link availability, and package.json field checks. Outputs Markdown + JSON summary.

meta.name: GitHub Repository Checker
meta.description: Perform a self-check on a specified GitHub repository and generate a report: repository metadata, latest release/tag, issue/PR statistics, key document presence, document external link availability, and package.json field checks. Outputs Markdown + JSON summary.

steps.name: Parse Repository Input
Fetch Repository Metadata
Fetch Latest Release/Tag
Fetch Issue/PR Statistics
Fetch Key Documents
Try to Fetch package.json
Analyze package.json
Collect Markdown Sources
Extract External Links from Markdown
External Link Check: HEAD
External Link Check: GET Fallback
Merge External Link Check Results
Generate Release Readiness Report

repo.title: GitHub Repository
repo.description: Required: target GitHub repository to check. Supports owner/repo or https://github.com/owner/repo (also accepts git@github.com:owner/repo.git).

ref.title: Branch/Tag (Optional)
ref.description: If empty, will automatically use repo.default_branch (fetched via GitHub API).

docPaths.title: Key Document Paths to Fetch from Repository (Optional)
docPaths.description: By default will fetch README/CHANGELOG/CONTRIBUTING/SECURITY/CODE_OF_CONDUCT/LICENSE. You can also append paths like docs/README.md here.

timeoutMs.title: Network Request Timeout (milliseconds)
timeoutMs.description: Both GitHub API and external link checks will use this value as the default timeout.

concurrency.title: External Link Check Concurrency
concurrency.description: Too high concurrency may cause rate limiting or many timeouts. Default 6.

maxLinks.title: Maximum Number of External Links to Check
maxLinks.description: Avoid too many external links in README causing long runtime. Default 120.

includeNonMarkdownFiles.title: Include Non-Markdown Text Files in Link Extraction
includeNonMarkdownFiles.description: Default false. Only processes .md/.markdown or text/markdown files.

examples.name: Check a Public Open Source Repository (Default Config)
examples.description: Input repo, get Markdown report + JSON summary + external link check results.

examples.name: Stricter: Check More Documents + More External Links
examples.description: Suitable for deep self-check before release: add paths like docs/README.md, increase maxLinks.

summary_json.title: Self-Check Summary (JSON)
summary_json.description: Structured summary: key results for repo/release/issues/docs/links/package.json, suitable for downstream automation consumption.

report_md.title: Release Readiness Report (Markdown)
report_md.description: Self-check report that can be directly pasted into GitHub issues/PRs/Release notes.

links_summary.title: External Link Check Summary
links_summary.description: Total external links/passed/failed and top_failed list.

links_results.title: External Link Check Details
links_results.description: Final check result for each external link (GET overrides HEAD).
